rows.author: J084
rows.title_full:
AN ACT INSTITUTING THE
MAGNA CARTA OF FILIPINO SEAFARERS
rows.abstract: Aims to recognize and uphold the rights and to promote the welfare of Filipino seafarers specifically the right to safe and secure workplace that complies with the safety standards, decent working and living conditions on board a ship, medical care, welfare measures and other forms of health and social protection, and fair terms and conditions of employment including salary commensurate to their rank, minimum number of working hours, and rest periods consistent with Philippine or international maritime conventions.

rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING REPUBLIC ACT 7160
rows.abstract:
Provides that Sec. 100 of R.A. 7610, otherwise known as the “Local Government Code” shall read as follows:
“Section 100. Meetings and Quorum; Budget. -
(a) The local school board shall meet at least once a month, as far as practicable every first week
of the month, or as often as may be necessary.

(b) All meetings of the local school board shall be publicly announced in the websites and social
media accounts of the local government unit, the DepEd district supervisor, parent - teacher associations and the public schools within the territorial jurisdiction of the local government,
and through such other means as would ensure utmost awareness and participation by all stakeholders, at least ten (10) days prior to the scheduled meeting.  Any interested school official or community leader may attend such meetings, but they will not be able to vote.

rows.title_short: Imposing Taxes On Offsite Betting Activities On Locally Licensed Cockfights And Derbies, Amending Section 125 Of The National Internal Revenue Code Of 1997, As Amended
rows.abstract:
Seeks to impose five percent (5%)tax on the  gross receipts derived from offsite betting activities on locally licensed cockfights and derbies and other derivative activities , and shall not be in lieu of taxes required by the local government units, and regulatory fees and charges imposed by government agencies.

Requires gaming operators to specify “Offsite Betting Activities on Locally Licensed Games” in disclosures and documentations required by the BIR and other regulatory government agencies and instrumentalities to help ensure that the government can monitor the activities of such operators.

Mandates the GAB to issue rules and regulations for the fair conduct of offsite betting on locally licensed cockfights and derbies, including devices required of gaming operators, agents, and other related parties.

INSTITUTING SERVICES FOR LEARNERS WITH DISABILITIES IN SUPPORT OF
INCLUSIVE EDUCATION, ESTABLISHING INCLUSIVE LEARNING RESOURCE
CENTERS IN ALL SCHOOL DISTRICTS, PROVIDING FOR STANDARDS, AND
APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.title_short: Instituting Services For Learners With Disabilities ( L W D S) In Support Of Inclusive Education Act
rows.abstract:
Seeks to provide inclusive education for children and youth with special needs by providing them appropriate public education and related services according to their needs, and in preparation for adult living and community life.

Provides partnership mechanism of the DepEd and the concerned agencies to coordinate and enter into cooperative agreement , arrangement or contract with other government agencies, private and non-profit agencies, institutions or organizations duly accredited or recognized by the government agencies, civil society, business and industrial sector, and other concerned sectors in the furtherance of the provisions of this Act. 

Creates an Inter-Agency Coordinating Council for Learners with Disabilities which shall be attached to the DepEd  for policy integration, harmonization, and coordination of functions.

Mandates the DepEd to undertake continuing research to identify and design programs that shall meet the full range of needs of LWDs.
rows.status: Republic Act RA11650 enacted on 2022-03-11
